title: Framework layout configuration schema
description: Validation schema for conf/framework.conf.yaml: where the embedding FRAMEWORK (the application integrating the harness) keeps the files the harness loads agnostically — skills, agents, instructions, prompts, templates, and the artifact schema registry. Paths are relative to the framework root ('.' = the root itself). The harness's own contracts (harness/contracts/) are harness-owned and resolved structurally, never configured. The WORKSPACE (the data plane the harness checks — this framework calls it the portfolio) is described separately by workspace.conf.yaml.

skills.description: Directory the framework's skills live under ('.' when colocated at the root).
